verdict.rationale: Mem0 doesn't document an explicit sandbox/staging mode, but an agent can auto-create its own account and mint an 'evaluation API key' from the terminal (docs-3, probe-rt-4), and the self-hosted/open-source option lets a user stand up an entirely separate instance with its own data (docs-4, docs-21) — both of which could serve as de facto sandboxes without touching a production project. There is no first-party 'test mode' toggle, separate sandbox API tier, or documentation of production/sandbox data isolation guarantees. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test environment flag or docs describing production-vs-test data isolation guarantees, and any hands-on confirmation that these workarounds actually isolate data safely.
